description: This file defines CUDA kernel structures and functions for sparse semi-structured packing in PyTorch's ATen library, including warp shuffles, tile packing, and metadata handling for GPU tensor operations.

classes.name: Tile8x8Masks
classes.description: Structure representing bitmask for 8x8 tile in sparse packing.

classes.name: Tile8x8Meta
classes.description: Metadata structure for 8x8 tile packing, including various meta fields.

classes.name: KernelTypes
classes.description: Template class encapsulating kernel types, parameters, and static methods for sparse semi-structured tile kernel operations.

methods.name: warp_shuffle_meta
methods.description: Performs warp shuffle to reorganize metadata bits for a 32-bit meta_ab value, optionally transposed.

methods.name: warp_shuffle_and_write_meta
methods.description: Shuffles metadata and writes it to global memory in a specific format.

methods.name: pack_4x4
methods.description: Packs a 4x4 tile based on indices, filling meta information, with optional transposition.

methods.name: sparse_semi_structured_tile_kernel
methods.description: Main kernel function for packing sparse semi-structured tiles, handling input loading, packing, transposing, and metadata storage.

methods.name: sparse_semi_structured_apply_kernel
methods.description: Kernel for applying the sparse semi-structured packing, responsible for processing tiles and storing packed data.
